description: Réseau TramWay du Maroc is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Geomatic. Après le lancement des deux réseaux TramWay de Rabat Salé et de Casablanca, le Maroc a connu un saut qualitatif dans le domaine des transports collectifs urbains. Coverage: Morocco. The portal files it under the publisher Geomatic (the item's credit line). Its tags are TramWay, Maroc, Morocco. The portal shows 2018-06-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is custom rights statement written on the portal listing (long text, see the linked page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
